name: Potions for Tomorrow
source:
Potions for Tomorrow is a visual novel in which you play as Margarida, a young potion-making witch that just arrived in town. 

Margarida will be in town for a week, but while she is there she wants to try to help as many people as possible with her potions. Meet various clients having their own problems and give them the potions they need so they can achieve a brighter tomorrow!

Made for NaNoRenO 2023.

[From [url=https://bosimba.itch.io/potions-for-tomorrow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在视觉小说《Potions for Tomorrow》中，你将扮演刚来到镇上的年轻魔药女巫Margarida。

Margarida只会在镇上停留一周，但她希望在此期间，用自己的魔药尽可能帮助更多的人。认识各有烦恼的客人，将他们需要的魔药交给他们，助他们迎来更美好的明天！

为NaNoRenO2023活动制作。

[摘自[url=https://bosimba.itch.io/potions-for-tomorrow]itch.io[/url]]
